liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (3 reviews): The Help, Slipknot, Franklin's sequence in the middle of the first set got the show going; The Help, Slipknot, Franklin's run was a standout of the show [16][19][27]
- **The Race Is On** (1 other source): Phil comes in big and loud on this song [12]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Loose Lucy was singled out as a highlight [19]
- **Truckin'** (1 other source): Static knocked out 22 seconds here and was patched; a one-second burst near 4:21 was left alone [5]
- **Dear Mr Fantasy** (1 review): Dear Mr. Fantasy stood out, with Brent playing with great force [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-05-05.141262.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-05-05.143960.InHouseFM.Dalton-Miller-Noel.t-flac1644**: FM broadcast; 22 songs; 155 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd90-05-05.dsbd.wiley.11660.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 150 min; rated 3.76/5 by 41 [11]. Said about its sound: The reviewer felt the recording could have sounded a star better; The reviewer's own audience tapes of this show sound good; The recording sounds quite nice [17][20][23]
- **gd1990-05-05.dsbd.nickspicks.4850.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [12]. Said about its sound: No flaws audible apart from cassette flips; the show is sloppy at times but very powerful [12]
- **gd1990-05-05.137021.set1.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 11 songs; 72 min [13]

## Around the show

- Held on Cinco de Mayo on a blazingly hot day; the band sounded rough but strong [16]
- Reaching the venue meant an hour and a half in 104-degree sun for the final mile [17]
- The crowd was extremely friendly, with people sharing water and supplies and introducing their friends to one another [17]
- A brutally hot, smoggy L.A. day in a rough neighborhood; the band wasn't invited back [18]
- Entry had no shakedown, and fans freely shared drinks and smokes in a respectful atmosphere [21]
- A hot show where the reviewer got a bad sunburn; the first set was long [27]
- After 38 shows, the reviewer heard many songs live for the first time here, including Race Is On, Loser and GDTRFB [20]
- The reviewer found the energy lower than the spring tour just finished or the upcoming Shoreline run, probably from heat [23]
- Makes a good companion to the following night's show [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-05-05.141262.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [1]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make this show complete [1]
- **gd1990-05-05.143960.InHouseFM.Dalton-Miller-Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Joe Noel and Charlie Miller; source: Tim Dalton Source: In house FM > Dat [5]. Also: Taken from a DAT of the live KPFK FM broadcast, supplied by Tim and transferred by Charlie; A patch from Mike French and Tom Darian fixed 22 seconds of heavy static [5]
- **gd90-05-05.dsbd.wiley.11660.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD>DAT>CDR [11]
- **gd1990-05-05.dsbd.nickspicks.4850.shnf**: transferred by Nickspicks; source: DSBD>Cass>DAT>CD>EAC(secure)>MKW-Act seekable SHN [12]
- **gd1990-05-05.137021.set1.sbd.miller.flac24**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [13]. Also: The first set comes from a soundboard master, not the mono FM source [13]
